これもまた、ひとつの世界と物語。: This is yet another world and another story.

そんな妖夢の気配に酔い痴れながら、怪奇幻想に魅入られた好事家たちはその都市の名前: Enthralled by the intoxicating aura of this mysterious dream, connoisseurs are seduced by bizarre fantasies as they begin to speak the names of cities.

ミスカトニック大学、秘密図書館。その歴史を紐解けば、禁断の知識を狙う閲覧者たちと: Miskatonic University's Secret Library. If one unravels its history, it tells a story of the struggle between readers who seek forbidden knowledge and the wardens who seal it away.
その内の何割かは、あるいは世界の命運を賭けた戦いだったのかも知れない。彼が知る事: Some portion of those struggles may have been battles with the fate of the world at stake. The incident he knew of was surely one of them.
ミスカトニック大学図書館長ヘンリー・アーミティッジは回顧する。誰も居ない図書室の: Miskatonic University's chief librarian, Henry Armitage, reminisces, staring into the empty darkness of the unoccupied library.
「……あの夜を思い出すな。忘れもしない。８月３日のことだ」: "......I remember that night. I will never forget it, the incident on August 3rd."
誰も居ないはずの図書室の、誰も居ないはずの闇がわなないた。: In the library where no one should be, the darkness where no one should be trembles.
「夜明けが近かった。夜鷹のけたたましい啼き声は、忌まわしいほどにリズミカルだった: "Dawn was approaching. The piercing cries of Whippoorwills echoed with a repulsive rhythm."
空気が一変した。何処からともなく生温かい風が吹く。: The atmosphere shifts abruptly. Out of nowhere, a warm breeze sweeps through.
風は腐臭にも似た臭気を孕んでいる。瘴気だ。瘴気の風だ。: The wind carries a putrid odor reminiscent of decay. It is miasma. It is a wind of miasma.
「番犬の雄叫び。魂を引き裂くような断末魔。図書館を充たす悪臭。ダンウィッチの怪異: "The watchdog's howl, those soul-rending death throes, and a stench which filled the library. They're the nightmarish memories brought by that Dunwich Horror."
風が吹き荒れる。瘴気を孕む異界の風に、書棚の魔導書が飛ばされる。頁が解けて、無数: The wind bellows. Caught in an otherworldly, miasmic wind, Grimoires are hurled from their shelves. Pages unbind, and countless sheets of paper drift in the air.
叩きつけるような暴風を正面から受け止め、だが老齢のアーミティッジは怯むことなく其: The elderly Armitage faces the intense storm head-on, undaunted. In his gaze, the fragments of Grimoires swirl.
さらに解ける。魔導書の頁、一枚一枚から『文字』が溢れ出し、急速な勢いで竜巻の中心: They disintegrate further. [Symbols] are overflowing from every single page, rapidly converging into a central vortex.
数万数億の文字が複雑に編まれてゆく。結晶する。: Tens of thousands--perhaps even hundreds of millions--of symbols intricately weave together. Then they materialize.
それは血のように紅い人影だった。: It is a silhouette, dyed a deep blood-red.
「ほう？ 私のことをご存知か。だが、それなら規則も知っていただきたい。今は閲覧時: "Hoh? Are we acquainted? However, you should know the rules. Now is not the time to be browsing."
「賊め……このミスカトニック大学秘密図書館に何の用だ？」: "Damn thief...... What are you plotting in this Miskatonic University's Secret Library?"
「いやよ、お爺ちゃん。そんな怖い顔しないで」: "Oh no, old-timer. Don't give me such a grim look."
くすくすと、紅い影が嗤う。その手の中に、一冊の魔導書があった。: With a giggle, the crimson shadow sneers. It clasps a Grimoire in its hand.
「わたしはただ、仲間を迎えに来ただけ」: "I have come merely to retrieve my companion."
手に持った魔導書を掲げる。アーミティッジは見た。その慄然たる題名を。: The figure raises the Grimoire in its hand. Armitage sees its dreadful title.
頁と頁の隙間から、無数の魔術文字が蟲のように這い出てくる。文字は絡み合い、繋がれ: From the gaps between pages, countless magical symbols crawl out like bugs. The symbols interweave, forming a long string before being absorbed by the scarlet shadow, going through its lips and into its mouth.
「ダンウィッチの怪異の同属か！」: "Are you the same type of being as the Dunwich Horror!?"
卵がひび割れるような音を、アーミティッジは聴いた。: Armitage hears a sound like an egg cracking.
紅い影の胸が、縦に裂ける。噴き出る鮮血は闇に映えて、綺羅綺羅と輝いていた。: The crimson shadow's chest tears open vertically. Fresh blood from the shade gushes forth, sparkling brilliantly in the dark.
飛び散る鮮血は、宙に真紅の魔法陣＝正方形×正方形＝回転式八芒星を描く。: It splatters, weaving a crimson magic circle mid-air = Square x Square = Drawing a spinning octagram.
空間が裂け、時空が流血した。今までとは比べ物にならない瘴気と臭気が、時空の向こう: Space is torn asunder, and space-time bleeds out. Exceeding the continuum, a miasma and stench unlike anything before flow in.
この気配と悪臭をアーミティッジは知っている。: Armitage knows this stench and this presence.
時空の向こう、異形の眼がこちらの世界を覗き込んでいる。: Beyond space-time, otherworldly eyes peek into this world.
異次元より伸びる無数の触手。: Countless tentacles extend from another dimension.
反射的に印を結ぶアーミティッジの周囲に、粉のようなものが舞う。: Around Armitage, a powdery substance flutters as he traces a seal reflexively.
粉は闇に輝き、空間に魔法陣を浮かび上がらせる。術式展開。: With the powder glittering in the dark, a magic circle emerges from empty space. A spell is cast.
ふたつの魔力が激突し、光と音と臭いと衝撃と思念とが荒れ狂い、火花を散らし、そして: Two magical forces collide--light, sound, stench, shockwaves, and thoughts raging wildly, scattering sparks, and then--
駆けつけたウォーラン・ライス教授とフランシス・モーガン博士が見たものは、爆発の傷: When Professor Warren Rice and Doctor Francis Morgan rush to the scene, what they notice first is the Secret Library ravaged by fresh scars from the explosion.
残留する瘴気は未だに濃く、館内は酷い悪臭に満ちている。: The remaining miasma is as dense as ever, filling the library with a terrible odor.
二人は知っている。この臭いの正体――思い出したくもない悪夢の正体を。: Both of them know. This scent's true nature--this nightmare's identity that they wish to forget.
図書館の中央、膝を突き蹲る、傷だらけのアーミティッジを見つけたモーガンが叫ぶ。倒: Morgan shouts as he spots a battered Armitage on his knees in the center of the library. Pushing past the fallen bookshelves in frustration, he rushes to his side.

大十字九郎。職業、魔導探偵。まあ、要するにオカルト絡みの事件を扱う何でも屋だ。: Daijuuji Kurou. Occupation: Occult Detective. Well, to put it simply, I'm a jack-of-all-trades who handles occult-related cases.
そんな俺がここ数週間、多忙を極めている。その諸悪の根源が……たった今、ぶっ倒した: Because of that, I've had my hands full for the past few weeks. The very source of all this evil is...... well, those creatures we just beat the living hell out of a moment ago.
ここ数週間、多発している怪異。それらはコイツらによって引き起こされていた。: Strange things have been occurring frequently over the past few weeks. They were caused by these things.
普段は不定形。だが時折こうして実体化し、街中で暴れ出す。その正体はこの通り――自: Normally, they're formless. Every now and then, though, they materialize like this and go on a rampage in the middle of town. As you can see, their true form is a puddle of blood moving with a will of its own.
今夜と同じように、もう何度もコイツらを倒している。だが怪事件は減るどころか増えて: Just like tonight, we've already taken them down countless times. Yet far from decreasing, the bizarre incidents only keep multiplying.
アルの知識を以ってしても正体不明な、今回の怪異。ここまで奇妙なのは、かれこれ前の: Even with all of Al's knowledge, the true nature of this phenomenon remains a mystery. We haven't seen anything this bizarre since the previous world.
アルが言わんとしているところは分かっている。それがまた、さらにこの事件の奇怪さを: I know what Al is going to say. That also fuels just how bizarre this incident is.
「お前に『近い』感じがある……か」: "You felt that they were 'similar' to you...... right?"
帰るなり、ソファーに向かって倒れ込む。心底、疲れた。いくらなんでも忙し過ぎる。: As soon as I got inside, I sank onto the sofa. I'm exhausted as hell. Whatever the circumstances might be, I'm way too overloaded right now.
暇よりはマシかも知れないが、これでは身体の方が持たない。: While it might be better than being unoccupied, my body is at its limit.
「覇道の小娘に報告しなくて良いのか？」: "Shouldn't we report this case to the Hadou girl?"
「今日はパス……明日で良いや……」: "I'll pass today...... Let's do it tomorrow......"
うるせえぞ、人外風情ども。だいたい報告するにしたって、いつもと同じ内容じゃねえか: Shut the hell up, you inhuman Peanut Gallery. I mean, even if we do file a report, won't it be the same shit as usual?
何の腐れ縁か――俺はこの世界でも、覇道財閥のお抱え探偵をやっている。: I don't know what kind of toxic relationship I've built with them--nonetheless, I'm still working as a private eye for the Hadou Enterprise in this world.
『ブラックロッジ』が存在しなくても、この街と俺を取り巻く環境は大して変わっていな: Even though [Black Lodge] no longer exists, this city and its atmosphere haven't changed much.
変わっていることがあるとすれば――: The one thing that has changed--
デモンベインが無いことくらいか。: Is the fact that Demonbane no longer exists.
そう。邪神の陰謀を砕いた今、魔を断つ剣は必要ない。アイツの永い戦いはようやく終わ: That's right. Now that we've thwarted the scheme of the Evil Gods, the Sword that Smites Evil is no longer needed. His long battle has finally come to an end.
もう居ないデモンベイン。デモンベインを忘れた世界。: Demonbane is no more. A world where Demonbane is forgotten.
ふと寂しく思うこともある。だけどこれで良いんだ。世界は未来へ向かっているのだから: Sometimes a wave of loneliness hits me out of nowhere. But it's better this way. After all, the world is moving toward the future.
……なんてな。感傷的になっている場合じゃない。: ......Yeah, as if. Now's not the time for me to get all sentimental.
今の問題は、例の件だ。あのファッキン血溜まりども、本気で厄介になってきた。: The problem right now is this whole case. Those fucking puddles of blood are getting seriously troublesome.
今のところ後れを取ることはないが、それでも決して楽な相手ではない。: So far I haven't been pushed onto the back foot, but even so, they're far from an easy opponent.
「このままじゃキリがねえ」: "At this rate there's no end to them."
「……元凶を突き止めんことにはな」: "......Not unless we pin down the source behind this."
元凶を突き止めようとしても、手がかりすら無いけどな。: Though even if we want to pin down the source, we don't have a single lead.
なにせヤツら、斃れて血溜まりになったと思ったら、すぐに蒸発して消えちまう。: After all, the moment they go down and collapse into puddles of blood, the bastards evaporate right before our eyes, vanishing without a trace.
「ええい、だからしっかりせんか」: "Jeez, can you get a grip already?"
「本当にアイツら、何ものなんだ……」: "Honestly, just what on Earth are they......?"
「それを調べるのが仕事だ……ったく」: "That's why investigating them is part of our job...... Good grief."
言いながら、アルは俺の横を通り過ぎる。: Saying so, Al passes by me.
「疲れたのは妾も同じだ。湯に浸かって身体を休める」: "I am exhausted as well. I shall soak in the bath and rest my body."
告げて、アルは浴室へ入っていった。部屋には俺とダンセイニが残される。: Saying that, Al enters the bathroom. Only Dunsany and I are left in the room.
「何がだっ！？ あっ、んん……っ！こ、こら、変なところ触るなっ！」: "Don't mind WHAT?! Ah, mm... H-Hey, do not touch me in strange places!"

「か、顔がにやけておるぞ！あ……あああっ……くぅぅんっ！……ま、またぁぁぁぁっ！: "Y-You're grinning?! Ah...... Aaaagh...... Kuun! N-Not agaaaiiin......!"
「しみじみ言うな！うくぅっ……そ、そこは……駄目ぇぇぇ……っ！」: "D-Don't say it with so much feeling! Ugh, kuuh...... N-Not there...... Don't......!"
「……いい加減にせんかッ色情狂がぁぁぁぁっ！」: "......ENOUGH OF THIS CRAP, YOU DAMN SEX MANIAAAAAC!"
「はぁ……はぁ……余計に……疲れるではないか……うつけが……っ」: "*Pant*... *Pant*... Now I am... even more exhausted... You utter fool..."
「痛てて…………ったく、今さら恥ずかしがる仲でもねえだろ……ブツブツ」: "Shit that hurts............ Man, what are you embarrassed for when we're already this close......? Grumble grumble."
「わ、妾は汝のように無節操ではないのだっ！」: "I-I am not so shameless as you!"

特に意味もなく、アルの髪を撫でる。アルはそれを黙って受け入れている。: For no particular reason, I stroke Al's hair. She accepts it in silence.
アルを軽く胸の中に抱いて、告げる。: I gently pull Al into my chest and speak.
「大したことじゃないのさ。ただ、ちょっとだけな。前のことを思い出したりして」: "It's no big deal. Just a little something. I was just thinking back on how things used to be."
『前世』ってのはつまり、『ブラックロッジ』が存在した世界……つまりデモンベインで: By 'previous life', in short, it was the world where [Black Lodge] once existed...... In other words, it was the time when I was fighting with Demonbane.
俺たちの知る暗黒時代は、歪んだ歴史が生み出したものだった。デモンベインの戦いによ: The dark age we knew was born of a distorted history. Through Demonbane's battle, that wrong timeline was corrected...... In this time, in this world, that mighty evil does not exist.
そしてあの戦いもまた、もう俺たちの記憶の中にしか存在しないのだ。: And that battle, too, only exists in our memories right now.
「これで良いんだって、分かってるんだけどな」: "I know this is the best for us, but......"
やれやれ。結局、おセンチになっちまった。こういうのは俺の性格には似合わないんだが: Good grief. I ended up getting sentimental after all. This kind of thing really isn't in my nature.
湯船の中、アルはそっと俺の手を握る。小さくて華奢な指が、俺の指と絡まり合う。優し: In the bathtub, Al softly grasps my hand. Her small, delicate fingers entwine with mine. She speaks in a gentle, quiet...... yet unwavering voice.
俺たちは一度別れ、だが再び廻り逢った。この小さな掌を、もう二度と離すまい。: We were parted once before, yet found our way back to each other. I will never let go of this small hand again.
そう。俺たちはずっと、ふたりで歩んでゆく。: That's right. We'll keep walking forward together, forever.
存在は無限に拡散し、世界へと融けてゆく。対して意識は無限に明瞭になり、世界の総て: My existence diffuses into infinity, dissolving into the world. In contrast, my consciousness becomes infinitely clear, sensing all things in the world.
世界間を移動するときは、いつもこのような感覚に囚われる。今の我は、実在と非実在の: Whenever I travel between worlds, I am always seized by this sensation. Right now, I exist within the wavering boundary between reality and non-reality.
それは魔術の深淵に近づく行為でもあり、自己を見失う危険な行為でもある。: This is an act that reaches close to the abyss of magic, and also a dangerous act that causes one to lose their very self.
深淵を覗き込むとき、深淵もまた此方を覗き込む――強大な『情報』の渦に呑み込まれれ: When you gaze into the abyss, the abyss also gazes into you--if swallowed by the mighty vortex of 'Information,' a human mind would be obliterated without a trace.
自我に幾重にも防壁を編み込み、心は宇宙の中心へと向かう激流、世界の中心から溢れ出: Weaving numerous layers of protection around my ego, my mind races through the turbulent currents of Azathoth raging between the torrent rushing toward the center of the cosmos and the muddy stream overflowing from the center of the world.
大いなる流れの只中にあって、我ら時空の魔術師は全知全能となる。: In the middle of the great flow, we, as Space-Time Magi, become omnipotent and omniscient.
だが無限の能力は一瞬たりとも魂の器に留まることはなく、ただ空虚に通り過ぎてゆくだ: However, that infinite power does not remain in the vessel of the soul for even a moment; it merely passes through in vain.
引き伸ばされた時間が急速に圧縮されてゆく。実世界での顕現が近い。其処はまた、新た: The Rubber Time is compressing rapidly. I am close to materializing in the real world. Once again, there will be a new playground.
良いだろう、玩弄者。踊らされてやる。: Very well, Teaser. I shall let you make me dance.
今回の件は我の迂闊さが招いたこと。彼奴との決着は、この手で付けさせてもらう。: Because of my own carelessness, this incident came to be. I will settle things with her by my own hands.
さあ、玩弄者。今度の遊戯は何だ？: Now, Teaser. What will the Game be this time?
顕現の瞬間。雑念が紛れ込んだ。: Intrusive thoughts creep in at the moment of my materialization.
自我の防壁をいとも容易く擦り抜け、怒涛の如く流れ込んでくる大質量の思念。: An immense sentiment flows into me like a surging wave, effortlessly slipping through the defenses of my ego.
その正体を我は知らない。だがそれはとても馴染みのあるものだ。世界間を移動するとき: I do not know its true identity. Yet it is deeply familiar to me. Whenever I travel between worlds, I always brush against this feeling.
何だ。何なのだ、この想いは。灼けるように熱くて。壊れそうなくらいに激しくて。: What is this? What is this feeling? It's fiery hot. So intense I feel like I'm about to break.
苛烈で壮絶な魂の衝動／燃焼／激動／疾走／爆発／嵐: A fierce and tremendous impulse / combustion / upheaval / sprint / explosion / tempest of the soul.
でも、それは、そんななのに、それは、強くて、優しくて、陽気で、愛しくて、: And yet, even so, it is strong, gentle, bright, and dear--
総ては、ウツロに、通り過ぎるだけ。全にして――無。: All things merely pass by into emptiness. All, and yet--nothing.
まず最初に詞在り。魔術文字が式を組み、識を生む。: In the beginning is the Word. Magical script weaves a formula, giving birth to consciousness.
空間に投影される術式。擬似的に構築された人体、その隅々に血を送り込む。: A magic formula is cast into space. It pumps blood into every corner of the pseudo-constructed human body.
血こそ我が存在。我が魔力の証明。我が魔術の源泉。: Blood is my existence. It is proof of my magic power. It is the source of my magic.
ヒト型の術式、未だ存在しない躰を血が満たしてゆく。紅く、宝石のように輝く術式。: Blood fills the humanoid magic formula, the body that is yet to exist. The magic formula shines crimson like a ruby.
血と術が融け合い、本物の躰を編み上げてゆく。「我」という存在を実証し、世界に承認: Blood and sorcery fuse together, weaving a real body. It substantiates the existence known as 'myself' and compels the world to acknowledge it.
そして我は此処に、新たな世界に立つ。: And here I am, standing in the new world.
最初に感じたのは風。身に纏う外套が強風に煽れ、はためく。: The first thing I feel is the wind. The cloak I wear is whipped by the gale and flutters.
次に音。遠くから聴こえる街の喧騒が、この世界の活気を物語っていた。: Next is sound. The bustle of the city heard from afar speaks of this world's vitality.
匂い。大気の匂い。違和感に気付く。何か――懐かしい。: Smell. The scent of the air. I notice something amiss. Something--nostalgic.
光。我は眼を開けた。その眼下に広がるものに、唖然とする。: Light. I open my eyes. I am astonished by what is unfolding below me.

お茶を持ってきてくれたメイドさんを横目に、俺たちは昨日の事件について話していた。: Glancing sidelong at the maid who brought us tea, we were talking about yesterday's incident.

短身痩躯の少年だった。少女と見まがう整った貌には、凛々しい戦士の表情が浮かんでい: It is a short, slender young boy. His finely sculpted face, which could be mistaken for that of a girl, bears the gallant expression of a warrior.

少年が十字剣を前に突き出し水平に構えると、甲高い金属音と共に二振りの小剣になって: The boy thrusts his cross sword forward, readying it horizontally. Then, with a high-pitched metallic sound, he splits it into two short swords.
分離した小剣を、少年はそれぞれ両手に取って構える。: Grabbing each of the newly separated short swords in both hands, he assumes his stance.
襲撃者が少年に殺意を叩きつける。: The assailant directs his murderous aura at the boy.
ほとんど物理的な圧力と化した殺気の余波に中てられて、ライカはよろめき膝を突く。: Leica stumbles and falls to her knees, caught amidst the near-physical pressure of that murderous aura.
子どもたちもまた、腰が抜けたようにその場にへたり込んだ。: Even the children sink down in their spots, paralyzed with terror.

刹那、濃密な闇が襲撃者を呑み込んだ。その様はヒト型に切り取られた深淵のようだ。: At that moment, a deep darkness swallows the assailant. It looks as though the abyss is tearing itself into the form of a human being.
凝固する闇が、失われた拳を再構築する。: The solidified darkness reconstructs its missing fist.
闇は瞬く間に黒光りする金属と化し、襲撃者の姿を別の存在に組み換えた。: The darkness transforms into black lustrous metal with a flash, recomposing the assailant's figure into another entity.
黒い装甲に身を包み、黒い機械の翼を広げる、ヒトの形をした闇黒。: Assuming this humanoid form, it dons black armor and spreads its dark mechanical wings.

少年が一歩前に踏み出す。: The boy begins to take a step forward.

次の瞬間に起こったことを、ライカたちには把握できなかった。ただ、彼女たちの横を紅: Leica and the children are unable to grasp what happened in the next moment. Only a crimson wind slips through next to them. With a wave of his crimson cloak, the boy bolts past them, faster than even the dark angel.
恐るべき速度で迫る二つの剣閃を、黒天使は辛うじて躱す。: The dark angel narrowly manages to avoid the streaks of two swords approaching him at terrifying speed.
だが刃は複雑な軌跡を描きながら追ってくる。: However, the blades run after him as they draw a complex pattern.
斬撃の合間を縫って躱し続け、速度が一瞬落ちた瞬間を狙って、拳を刃に叩き込む。: As he continues to evade, weaving his way through the gaps between their slashes, he aims for the split seconds where their speed drops momentarily, driving his fist into them.
一本の小剣が、回転しながら宙を舞い、遠くの床に突き刺さった。: A single short sword goes spinning through the air and embeds itself in the floor far away.
もう一方の刃が軌跡を変える。斬撃から刺突へ。空気を裂き、黒天使の喉笛を狙う。: The other blade alters its trajectory. From a slash to a thrust. Tearing through the air, it aims at the throat of the dark angel.
黒天使は紙一重で躱す――が、逃げ切れず刃が肩を抉る。: The dark angel manages to dodge the blow by a hair's breadth--yet, he fails to dodge it completely as the blade gouges his shoulder.
裂かれた装甲の下から噴き出す鮮血。: Fresh blood gushes out from underneath his cut-open armor.
不利を悟った黒天使は、距離を取ろうと飛び退く。礼拝堂の扉まで一気に跳躍し――だが: The dark angel, realizing that he's at a disadvantage, leaps back in an attempt to keep his distance. He leaps all the way to the chapel's door in one swift motion--but he notices something.
小剣を失った方の掌、真っ直ぐに黒天使に向けて伸ばされている。: The boy's palm, without his short sword, extends towards the dark angel.
広げた掌を、もう一方の手に持った小剣で浅く傷つける。: He inflicts a shallow cut on his outstretched palm with the short sword in his other hand.
「血は灼け、爆ぜる」: "Be scorched and torn asunder by my blood."
如何なる怪異か、滴る血は中空にて静止した。静止した血は時間を巻き戻したかの如く逆: His dripping blood begins to stall in mid-air, akin to something of an otherworldly nature. The blood, once still, now reverses itself in a fashion similar to that of time rewinding, drawing a magic circle before his open palm.
光が爆ぜる。同時、宙に血で描かれた魔法陣は燃焼し、眩く光り輝く火球に変わる。: Light bursts forth. Simultaneously, the blood-painted magic circle in the air combusts, transforming into a dazzlingly bright fireball.
白く爆ぜる焔の奥、確かな質量を持つ何かが顕現していた。少年は焔に怯むことなく、そ: Something with a definite mass is materializing amidst the white, blazing flames. The boy grabs it from the flames without flinching--
次の瞬間、黒天使の腕が吹き飛んだ。両手を失った状態で呆然と佇む黒天使の視線の先、: In the next moment, the dark angel's arm is blown away. Following the gaze of the dark angel, who stands dumbfounded and now armless, the new object in the boy's hand is--
「やはり構成が甘い。まだ貴様らはこの世界に馴染んでいない」: "As I thought, your composition is weak. Your kind have yet to acclimate to this world."
重厚なる黒。苛烈なる赤。装飾を施されながらも無骨。何より凶暴。前面下方に設置され: Deep black. Intense crimson. Ornamental yet crude, and most of all, violent and cruel. Destruction given form, in whose front-mounted magazine all of his fighting spirit is stored.
「馴染む前に粉砕してやる」: "I will grind you to dust before you have a chance to acclimate."
手に残った小剣が無数の魔術文字になって崩れ、文字列を再構成する。: The remaining short sword in his hand disintegrates into innumerable arcane symbols, rearranging themselves into a new sequence of characters.
新しく編まれる魔術式。それは赤い魔銃と対になるべく、顕現する。: A new magic formula is spun. It manifests itself to match the crimson magic pistol.
精錬された銀。耽美なる銀。研ぎ澄まされた刃の如く美麗。何より冷酷。六ある弾倉の最: Pure silver. Elegant silver. Beautiful like a finely honed blade, and most of all, cold and cruel. Murder given form, from the bottom of whose six-round cylinder death shall spew.
少年の両手に握られた二挺魔銃。即ち――: In his hands, he clutches the two magic guns. Namely--
数十回の銃声は一瞬も途切れることなく連続。ただ一度の爆音となって響いた。: Dozens of gunshots fire in unbroken succession, resounding as a single explosive roar.
撃ち尽した銃身は熱と魔術文字により、幽かな光を浮かび上がらせていた。: A faint light emerges from the heat and magic symbols on the discharged gun barrels.
クトゥグアの空薬莢が床に転がっている。さらにイタクァの弾倉から六つの空薬莢を棄て: Cthugha's empty cartridges roll on the floor. Furthermore, six empty shells are discarded from Ithaqua's cylinder.
その間、襲撃者は微動だにしなかった。イクタァの空薬莢が床に落ちる音――それを合図: The assailant remains motionless for the whole duration. With the sound of Ithaqua's empty cartridges dropping on the floor as the signal--a change is about to occur.
連続して爆ぜる襲撃者の躰。全身から噴き出る鮮血。襲撃者の全身が崩れ、薄れてゆく。: The assailant's form bursts open in succession. Fresh blood spurts from all over his body. His entire body disintegrates and fades away.
教会を血で染め上げ――残ったのは血痕と、礼拝堂をたゆたう血の霧だけ。: The church is soaked in blood--all that is left are bloodstains and bloody mist that lingers in the air of the chapel.
それもまた、何処から吹いたとも知れぬ風に運ばれ、散ってゆく。: Even they are being carried away, dispersed by a wind blowing from God knows where.
ライカたちは呆然とした様子で、少年を見る。少年は襲撃者が崩れ去った後の、虚空を見: Everyone shares a look of astonishment as they observe the boy. After the assailant fades away, the boy stares into the void.
その眼が見るのは、血染めの光景だけではない。その眼が視るのは魔術師の世界――世界: His eyes see not only the blood-stained sight. Those eyes see the world of magi--the movements of Azathoth that construct the world.
「術式を破壊し切れていない――逃がしたか」: "His magic formula wasn't thoroughly destroyed--did I let him escape?"
少年がゆっくりとライカたちの方を振り返る。凄絶な戦いを見せた少年の視線に、子ども: He slowly turns his head in the direction of her group. The children are slightly intimidated by his look due to his fierce battle from earlier. However.
先ほどまで戦士の瞳――敵を斃す手段を検索し検証し決断し決行する冷酷さ、無慈悲さを: His gaze, which exuded the aura of a warrior until now --where the mercilessness and ruthlessness of searching, inspecting, deciding, and carrying out the means to annihilate the enemy lie within--is now brimming with a gentle glow.
それは優しさであり愛しさであり、また戸惑いやはにかみも含んだ、複雑な彩だ。その深: There is kindness and affection, mixed with bewilderment and shyness in that complex hue. Everyone feels a faint sense of deja vu in those deep green eyes.
紅い外套が翻る。少年は高らかと割れたステンドグラスに向かって跳躍した。: His crimson cloak flutters. The boy leaps high toward the shattered stained glass.
空中で外套が翼のように広がる。: His cloak expands in mid-air like a pair of wings.
少年の躰があり得ない浮力を得た。: The boy's body gains an impossible levity.
ライカの制止の声も届かず、少年はそのままステンドグラスの向こうへと、飛び去ってし: Just like that, he has flown off beyond the window, ignoring her plea.
「……お礼、言い損ねちゃったね」: "I didn't even get a chance to express my gratitude......"
割れたステンドグラスの向こうからは夜空が覗けている。少年が去った空。: From the other side of the broken stained glass, the night sky can be seen. It's the same sky the boy disappeared to.
魔術の才を秘めるアリスンは、あの少年に常ならざるものを感じ取る。: Alison, who possesses a hidden gift of magic, senses something unusual about him.

唐突にそんな声が聴こえた。空気を介しての声ではない。念話だ。嫌な予感が込み上げて: Suddenly, I hear a voice. It isn't a voice transmitting through the air; it is telepathic communication. An uncomfortable hunch swells within me.

当然、俺たちも吹き飛ばされた。空中でぐちゃぐちゃに掻き混ぜられるような感覚。手足: Naturally, we are getting blasted as well. I feel like I'm being frantically tossed about up in the air. The shockwave is so intense that it might tear my limbs apart.
黒翼で全身を包み込み、ガードする。: I guard myself by wrapping black wings around me.
見れば風が――風から生じる衝撃波が――衝撃波から生じる『何か』が、無形の落とし子: Looking closely, the wind--the shockwave born from the wind--and 'something' born from the shockwave are pulverizing the Formless Spawns into minuscule pieces, turning them into black dust.
ウェスパシアヌスの、三つの人面疽が同時に泣き叫ぶ。人面疽の叫びは不可視の障壁とな: The three human-faced tumors of Vespasianus shriek in unison. Their howl becomes an invisible barrier, driving the wind of destruction away.
だがウェスパシアヌスの貌には、明らかな焦りの表情が浮かんでいた。: However, a clear look of panic surfaces on Vespasianus's face.
「ハスターの魔風だと！？」: "Is this the magical wind of Hastur!?"
ハスターの名に、ひとりのガキを思い出す。このウェスパシアヌス同様、この世界には存: The name Hastur reminds me of a certain little brat. He, like Vespasianus, is a horror who shouldn't exist in this world. One of the Anticross, who obtained Hastur's magical power.
だが、この風の担い手は違う。放たれた風は、超音速で飛翔する飛行体が残した衝撃波だ: But this wind caster is different. The released tempest is a shockwave left by a supersonic aircraft.
視認できない速度で飛んでいたソレは、今は上空でゆっくり大きく弧を描いて旋回する。: What was once flying at a speed invisible to the naked eye now slowly traces a large arc through the sky.
昆虫のような蝙蝠のような機械のような――なんとも奇妙な飛行体だった。: It is a terribly otherworldly aircraft--similar to that of an insect, a bat, and a machine.
「余所見をしている場合ではないぞ、ミスター」: "Now's not a good time for you to get distracted, mister."
いつからそこに居たのだろう。気配すら感じさせず、その老人はウェスパシアヌスの背後: How long has he been there, I wonder? The elderly man has been standing behind Vespasianus without revealing even a trace of his presence.
「貴方も、あの小僧と同類かね？」: "Are you of the same ilk as that young brat?"
睨めつけるような仕草。だがその眼の動きは、サングラスに隠されていて判らない。: He appears to be glaring. But I can't perceive his eye movements since they're hidden behind his sunglasses.
危険を感じたウェスパシアヌスが、人面疽の呪力を解き放とうとする。: Sensing the threat, Vespasianus attempts to unleash the magical power of his tumors.
だがサングラスの老人の動きはそれより速かった。: But the man moves faster than that.
黄色のボロ布が袖口から伸びる。: Yellow rags extend from his cuff.
ボロ布はウェスパシアヌスに絡みつき、全身を拘束した。: The rags twist around Vespasianus, restraining him.
サングラスの老人が大きく飛び退いた。: The old man in sunglasses takes a giant leap backward.
老人の手を離れても、黄色の布はよりきつくウェスパシアヌスを締めつける。: Although he had let go, the yellow cloth continues to tie Vespasianus even harder.
「ちょっと強めに行くよ」: "I'm going to hit you a little hard."
上空を旋回していた飛行体が動きを変えた。ウェスパシアヌスの上空で急上昇。一気にＵ: The aircraft that is circling overhead shifts direction. It swiftly ascends above Vespasianus. After making a sharp u-turn, it crashes down in a vertical line.
飛行体は一瞬で音速を超え、光になった。落雷のような光線がウェスパシアヌスごと大地: Suddenly, it exceeds the speed of sound and transforms into light. A thunderbolt-like beam pierces through the earth and Vespasianus.

無論、ウェスパシアヌスも無事でいられるはずがない。: Of course, not even Vespasianus is unharmed.
紅い華がぱっと咲くように全身が爆ぜた。荒れ狂う風が一瞬で血の彩に染まる。: His entire body explodes like a rapidly blooming crimson flower. The rampaging wind is instantly dyed the color of blood.
大地を穿った飛行体はどうなっただろう？血風の向こうに眼を凝らす。: What happened to the aircraft that pierced the earth? I peer beyond the bloody wind.
飛行体の姿は何処にも見当たらない。ただ爆心地には、ひとつの小柄な人影があった。兇: I can't see it anywhere. However, there is a petite humanoid figure in the epicenter. Standing in the center of the violently raging magical wind, that figure is--
「レディ、どうだ？ 仕留めたか？」: "Lady, how was it? Did you take him down?"
荒れ狂う魔風の渦は徐々に小さくなり、いずれは完全に消滅する。まさにその瞬間だった: The raging enchanted vortex gradually becomes smaller; eventually, it disappears completely. It is precisely at that moment.
一陣の血風が、魔風の渦から飛び出した。血風はもの凄いスピードで、二重螺旋を描きな: From within the magical cyclone, a bloody wind jumps out. The wind, ascending towards the heavens at a terrific speed, draws a double helix.
既に時遅し。血風は既に天に消えた。少女は、深くため息をつき。: It is already too late. The bloody wind has vanished into the heavens. The girl lets out a deep sigh.

老人が上空の俺たちを見上げた。表情はやはりサングラスで分かり辛い。だがその口調に: He looks up at us, who are still floating in the sky. It's difficult to discern his expression because of his sunglasses. Yet there's a carefree and lighthearted demeanor in his tone.
「久しいな。大十字九郎君」: "Long time no see. Mr. Daijuuji Kurou."
「元気そうで何よりだ」: "Glad that you're still kicking and well."
「初っ端の挨拶がそれかね」: "Is that really the first thing you have to say to me?"

割れたステンドグラス。そして床に残された、大きな血痕。まず間違いなく、例の血の化: The stained glass window is broken. Moreover, there's a huge bloodstain left on the floor. It's most likely those blood monsters.
「よく分からない……紅い影が怖い貌の男の人になって――」: "I have no idea...... There was a crimson shadow that turned into a scary-looking man."

「黒いヨロイ着てて、ロボットのハネが生えてるんだ」: "He was wearing black armor and grew a pair of robotic wings behind him."
俺とアルは思わず顔を見合わせた。久しく見せなかった、アルの深刻な貌。多分、俺も似: Al and I involuntarily exchange glances. A grave expression she hasn't shown in a long time crosses her face. Chances are, I'm making the exact same face.
あり得ないことだ。だけど俺たちはついさっき、その『あり得ないこと』に襲われたのだ: That's impossible. However, we were just under attack by 'the impossible' moments before. We have no choice but to accept it as fact.
「よく無事だったな……」: "It is a wonder you all made it out unharmed......"
「助けてもらった……誰に？」: "Someone saved you guys...... who was it?"
「怖い表情してたけど、可愛い男の子だったなぁ」: "Although there was a frightening look on his face, he was a pretty cute boy."
「いや……そんな嬉しそうな顔すんな」: "Er...... Don't be looking all happy like that."
「凄かったのよ～っ。こう、剣を２本構えていて、見えないくらいのスピードで戦って」: "That kid was so cool~. He was wielding his swords with both hands like this, and he moved so fast we couldn't even see the fighting."
「鉄砲も使っていた。二つ同時に、こうやってアクション映画みたいに」: "Oh, and he used guns too. He used two at the same time, like something straight out of an action movie."
……なんて俗っぽくて、恥ずかしいヤツなんだ。大衆迎合だの、受け狙いだの、記号だけ: ......What a tacky, embarrassing guy. Let's mock him for pandering to the masses, fishing for cheap thrills, and being a shallow walking trope.
しかし、本当に何者なのだろう？この怪事件に何か関わりがある人物なのだろうか。: Either way, who the hell is this guy? Could he have something to do with these weird cases?
分からない。結局は何も分からないままだ。ただひとつ確実に分かっているのは――: I don't get it. In the end, I still don't know anything at all. The only thing I know for sure is--
外ではシュリュズベリイ先生と、先ほどの少女が俺たちを待っていた。: Professor Shrewsbury and the girl from earlier are waiting for us outside.
「退学したと聞いていたが、何だ。真面目に精進しているではないか」: "I'd heard you dropped out, and yet look at you. You've been applying yourself quite diligently after all."
「成り行きだよ」: "I'm just going with the flow, that's all."
「ああ、ミスカトニック大学で世話になった先生さ」: "Ah, he's a Miskatonic University professor, one who helped me a lot."
先生は頷いてアルに手を差し出し、握手を求める。: The professor nods and holds out his hand to Al for a handshake.
「ラバン・シュリュズベリイだ。お会い出来て光栄だ、アル・アジフ嬢」: "I am Laban Shrewsbury. It is a privilege to meet you, Lady Al Azif."
「そこまで知っておるのか」: "You know that much about me, huh?"
「表沙汰にはなっていないがね。陰秘学科のお偉方は大騒ぎだったぞ。まさか失われた伝: "The public isn't aware of your existence, but there's a huge uproar among the bigwigs of the Occultic Division. Who would have thought that we would find the legendary lost Grimoire here?"
まさか秘密図書館に引き篭もっていたとは思うまい。: They'd never guess she was just cooped up in the secret library the whole time.
